about: Starter list: 348 native plants. The first 98 were researched for Roger Mills County, Oklahoma, with county records noted. The rest are common natives from across the US, with typical sizes, bloom times and growing needs from general references, compiled with AI assistance and not individually verified. Bloom months vary with climate; use “Check for this garden” to see when each plant flowers near you and whether it's recorded in your county.
